remarks: A Refined gated Westover residence showcasing exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design. This high end home offers four spacious bedrooms & 6 bathrooms, each with its own ensuite bath, along with elegant interiors highlighted by a dramatic two story foyer, rich hardwood floors, custom millwork, and extensive marble detailing. The gourmet kitchen features a stunning imported marble island with subzero refrigerator & freezer with an opening to the family room with fireplace & cathedral ceilings, ideal for entertaining & a butler's pantry, Wood burning with a massive stone fireplace enhance the warmth and character throughout. A traditional floor plan provides well scaled formal living and dining rooms complemented by an inviting family room. Additional spaces include a sun filled walk out lower level with above grade exposure-ideal for recreation, gym, or extended living-and a second floor bonus room/playroom with vaulted ceilings. A unique opportunity in Westover with close proximity to downtown Stamford & the Greenwich border.
